items.title: Micron Stock Has A New Profit Floor, But Did It Build A Ceiling Too?
items.summary: Management signed deals to guarantee years of record profits, yet the stock is slipping, a sign the market is more worried about the ceiling than excited about the floor.

items.title: MaxLinear Stock Sells At A Price Its Trailing Year Cannot Explain
items.summary: MaxLinear stock trades on multiples measured over a trailing year, while the infrastructure business that would justify them is only now the company's largest.

items.title: QUALCOMM (QCOM) Stock Looks Reasonable Even As Earnings Stay Cheap
items.summary: QUALCOMM stock has delivered a 59.9% return over the past three years, yet current checks suggest the shares now sit close to their intrinsic value on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) basis while still looking inexpensive on some market multiples. With mixed signals on valuation, investors are weighing a solid historical return profile against a set of fairness indicators rather than a clear bargain. items.title: What Quadrupled Intel Stock Was Not Foundry Customers
items.summary: Demand for its server chips runs ahead of what Intel can make, and the price now carries a build-out that is still years from finished.

items.title: Billionaire David Tepper Trimmed Micron and Sold out of SanDisk. Here’s the New AI Stocks He’s Buying
items.summary: David Tepper just posted a 32% return in six months riding memory chips, then quietly dumped his winners and moved the money somewhere most AI investors are completely ignoring.

items.title: QCOM: A Cash Gusher At A Marked-Down Price
items.summary: The market is punishing a chip giant's stock while it offers a cash return that most blue chips can't match, forcing a hard look at the engine inside.

items.title: What Separates AVGO From Its Peers Right Now
items.summary: This chip giant's profits are near the top of its class, but its stock performance is stuck in the middle of the pack. Has the market correctly spotted a flaw in the growth story.

items.title: Broadcom Sinks 6% as BofA Flags $370B in AI Debt, AMD Climbs 4% on Baird’s $1,250 Call
items.summary: Two AI chip giants moved in opposite directions Friday as Wall Street put a massive dollar figure on a financing structure that Broadcom and Nvidia both use, raising questions about which companies benefit from AI's debt-fueled buildout and which carry the hidden risk.
